review_candidates.title: Customer Support Engineer
review_candidates.description: About The Company Sumtracker is a leading inventory management and replenishment software tailored for Shopify and Amazon merchants. Since its inception in 2020, the company has rapidly grown to serve over 2,000 e-commerce brands across more than 50 countries. Sumtracker is a bootstrapped and profitable enterprise committed to delivering a product that genuinely meets customer needs and enhances their operational efficiency. Our small but dynamic team is based in Gurugram, working in-office at Patina Tower near Sikanderpur Metro Station in DLF Phase 1. We pride ourselves on fostering a collaborative environment that values innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement. For more information about our solutions and company vision, visit our website at https://www.sumtracker.com. About The Role We are seeking a dedicated Customer Support Engineer to join our team, a role that sits at the intersection of technical troubleshooting and customer service. The ideal candidate will possess a strong aptitude for diagnosing technical issues, working with logs, APIs, and integrations to resolve customer problems effectively. This role demands a problem-solver who enjoys unraveling complex issues such as Shopify sync failures, webhook malfunctions, or marketplace integration rate-limit problems. The Customer Support Engineer will serve as the primary point of contact for technical issues faced by our customers, providing clear, jargon-free explanations of solutions and workarounds. Additionally, this role involves close collaboration with our engineering and product teams to escalate genuine bugs, contribute to knowledge bases, and improve overall customer experience. The position offers an excellent opportunity for individuals seeking ownership of their work and a chance to make a tangible impact on our product and customer satisfaction. Qualifications The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of experience in a technical support, support engineering, or a similar customer-facing technical role, preferably within a SaaS environment. A strong technical aptitude is essential, with familiarity in reading logs, working with APIs, and understanding product architecture. Hands-on experience with SQL, webhooks, or API integrations will be highly advantageous. Excellent communication skills are required to explain technical concepts in simple terms to customers and internal teams. A customer-centric mindset, coupled with a proactive approach and the ability to work independently, is vital. Candidates should demonstrate ownership of their tasks, the ability to manage multiple issues simultaneously, and a passion for helping customers succeed. Responsibilities This role involves high ownership and individual contribution, with responsibilities including: Diagnosing and resolving technical issues reported by customers, including bugs, integration failures, configuration errors, and API problems. This involves reproducing issues, analyzing logs, and identifying root causes. Escalating genuine bugs to the engineering team with detailed reproduction steps to facilitate quick resolution. Managing customer expectations by providing timely updates on the status of fixes and workarounds. Developing a deep understanding of Sumtracker’s architecture, including reading logs, making API calls, and troubleshooting integrations with platforms like Shopify, Amazon, and other marketplaces. Creating and maintaining documentation such as help center articles, FAQs, and internal runbooks to streamline support processes and enhance knowledge sharing. Supporting onboarding and implementation processes for complex accounts, ensuring a smooth transition and optimal setup for new customers. Benefits Joining Sumtracker offers numerous benefits, including a competitive salary with annual increments, ensuring your compensation grows in line with your contributions. You will have opportunities for professional growth through taking on significant responsibilities and ownership of projects. You think not only technically but also analytically, and can assess and prioritize security risks in a structured way. You enjoy familiarizing yourself with new technologies and security topics and continuously developing your knowledge. You enjoy working in a team, take responsibility for your topics, and drive them forward independently. You communicate confidently in German and English and can explain complex topics clearly, including when interacting with clients. You do not just want to implement solutions, but actively help shape them and contribute to real success in projects and in building new topics. You already have experience in a consulting environment or in working with clients. review_candidates.description: Description About Xe Xe is a cross-border payments platform. We help SMEs and consumers in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand collect, convert, hold, and send money across markets. Each year, over 300 million people use Xe for currency information and over 350,000 use us to send money overseas. Today, we're rebuilding the platform layer behind cross-border payments for corporate and consumer clients. We're small enough that your code ships fast and your decisions matter, and Euronet Worldwide (Nasdaq: EEFT) backs us so the problems stay real-scale. About This Role We're hiring a mid-level full-stack engineer who likes owning real problems end-to-end, from API design and frontend experience through to backend services, production reliability, and launch. You already use AI as part of how you think, build, test, and ship. You'll write code that moves money in production, build and modernize the platform across the stack, and ship customer-facing features as Xe rebuilds its platform layer. You'll work in a small engineering team with direct access to product, design, and compliance, own services in production, make design decisions within your domain, and partner with architects and team leads on bigger design decisions. What You'll Do Build and ship features across the stack that move money and manage multi-currency balances across a range of domains, including onboarding, KYC and KYB, payment initiation, FX, settlement, and other supporting services. Ship customer-facing features that customers use every day, from the interface through to the services behind them. Own your services in production, including reliability, observability, on-call, and incident response. Partner with product, design, and compliance from problem framing through launch. Use agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) daily across prototyping, refactoring, testing, and documentation. Help modernize the platform by taking parts from legacy services into the modern stack, alongside architects and team leads in your domain. Strong backend proficiency in C# / .NET preferred; other OOP languages welcome (Java, Kotlin, Go, or equivalent). Solid SQL and relational database fundamentals. Writing and maintaining tests as part of how you ship. Daily use of agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) across the SDLC. Production experience on AWS, including hands-on deployment and native services such as SQS, DynamoDB, S3, ECS, and Lambda. Solid CS fundamentals and pragmatic system design. Strong communication and collaboration across engineering, product, and design. Nice-to-have Payments, FX, or regulated-industry experience. Service-oriented or microservices architecture experience. CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices. Frontend fundamentals: responsive design, accessibility, web performance, and internationalization. Experience with caching solutions like Memcached or Redis. Experience using project management and documentation tools like Jira and Confluence. Knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman or Bruno. Writing automated tests alongside development with AI tools (Claude Code or equivalent).
